sasha: INC-834 postmortem action items are in the RCA. Need owners + dates for rollforward, canary, docs — quick sweep?
incident-bot: INC-834 transitioned to postmortem. RCA created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-834
maria: I can own canary validation — target 2026-03-28 EOD. Will need platform help for traffic shaping. @jonathan can you confirm?
jonathan: Yep, I can do traffic shaping. I'll open a config PR in infra repo, ETA 2026-03-27. @alex can you take monitoring/alerts for the canary?
alex: I can own alerts + dashboard. Need expected error rate thresholds and p95 targets to wire alerts. Sasha, can you paste the postmortem thresholds?
sasha: PTL: thresholds we used in the incident analysis:
```
error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page
p95_latency > 500ms for 10m -> warn
```
Also need runbook update to include fallback model mapping and rollback steps. @pia can you triage docs?
pia: On it — I'll update the runbook and public-facing postmortem notes by 2026-03-29. Will add a short rollback play and where to find model pins.
maria: Quick question — who owns the rollback automation if the canary fails? Proposal: eng-platform owns rollback automation; eng-ml owns the manual rollback guide and verification steps.
jonathan: Agree. I'll take the automation PR (branch: inc834/rollback-automation). Plan to start after traffic config PR lands (after 2026-03-27). Ping me when canary starts.
alex: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboard panels and the alert links, and hook the runbook actions to the alert actions.
sasha: Summary for RCA update: canary validation = maria (due 2026-03-28), traffic config & automation owner = jonathan (config due 2026-03-27, automation PR post-config), monitoring/dashboard = alex (due 2026-03-27), runbook/docs = pia (due 2026-03-29). If no objections by EOD today I'll update the RCA with these owners. :eyes:
maria: No objections from me. +1
jonathan: +1
pia: +1
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem action due dates will receive automated reminders 24h before deadline.
